message: I love having a solid plan for those "uh-oh" moments when my phone or tech decides to take a nap at the worst possible time. Financial preparedness is one of those behind-the-scenes essentials that can really make a difference when life throws a curveball. I found a resource that breaks down the basics, and it’s a great reminder to have a few financial safety nets in place. What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared when the unexpected happens? 🤔
